originalPrompts.name: three-kingdoms-atlas
originalPrompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production portrait sprite atlas for a first-person Three Kingdoms reincarnation quiz. Create exactly1536x2048 pixels, ONE continuous atlas divided into exactly3 columns x4 rows of equal512x512 square tiles. NO gutters, NO lines, NO labels, NO typography, NO tile frames, NO decoration between tiles. Bust portraits all directly FRONT FACING, face and torso square to camera, both eyes visible and making EYE CONTACT as the player's mirrored face, consistent face scale and centered in every tile. All have same plain dark teal background. Original nostalgic detailed PC-98 / 1990s RPG pixel art, crisp visible pixel clusters, rich expressive high detail; no blur and not extremely low-res. Do not copy an existing game's sprites. Exact row-major order:
row1 left Zhuge Liang (black scholar cap, white feather fan held low, composed beard); center Cao Cao (red/dark gold official hat, short sharp beard, shrewd eyes); right Liu Bei (green/gold noble cap, gentle face).
row2 left Guan Yu (red face, long dark beard, green headwrap); center Zhang Fei (large dark beard, fierce round eyes, hearty energetic expression); right Zhao Yun (silver helmet, handsome calm young warrior).
row3 left Sun Quan (purple/bronze ruler cap, short beard, poised); center Zhou Yu (red/gold general headwear, handsome young commander); right Sima Yi (dark high scholar cap, narrow observant eyes, greying narrow beard).
row4 left Huang Zhong (aged white beard, bronze helmet); center Lu Bu (two long pheasant plumes headwear, strong handsome face); right Diao Chan (adult woman, elegant green/gold hair ornaments, intelligent poised face, modest collar).
Every tile is independently centered with headgear contained in its own tile. Faces all point directly at camera, NEVER three-quarter or profile. Enough surrounding space in each tile for oval mirror cropping. No text, no labels, no weapons extending across tiles.
